    • toggle

      public boolean toggle(int deckIndex)
      Flips the selection state of one upgradable card. An already selected card is unselected, which is always allowed so the player can revise a choice after reaching the cap. An unselected card is selected only while the cap has room; at the cap the call changes nothing.
      Parameters:
      deckIndex - The current deck Index of the chosen card
      Returns:
      true if the card is selected after this call, false if it is not
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the deck index is not an upgradable option
